reviews.author: Charissa Foong
reviews.text:
I love love love Binq!!!!
One of my favourite bingsu places.
They have hidden menu, apple crumble and strawberry cheesecake. Do try to ask for that when you're there. Not sure if they still do serve it but it's absolutely delicious. I do hope they add it to their permanent menu.

reviews.author: erine umaira
reviews.text: Excellent service! The front staff, Hazmi, was handling the crowd alone but remained so calm and friendly. Fast service even during peak hour. Big credit also to the rest of the team working today, everyone was great! And the bingsu was absolutely delicious! Truly deserves recognition!

reviews.author: agnes P
reviews.text: We tried the Roasted Soybean Oolong Bingsu and it was delicious! 😋 The bingsu shavings were incredibly fine and stayed powdery soft until the last bite. I loved being able to choose my own toppings, served in separate bowls. 🍨 A perfect treat for friends or a date! ✨

reviews.author: Aurora
reviews.text: As usual, binq doesn’t disappoint with their bingsus!! I’ve been to other binq’s outlets multiple times but decided to try this one today because it was near me. The hokkaido milk rose strawberry cheesecake is a limited edition flavour but it was sooo good 😍

reviews.author: MomoYang
reviews.text:
My friend and I were craving something cold after dinner, so we decided to make a spontaneous dessert run after seeing so many people talking about BINQ. To our surprise, there’s actually an outlet just a few minutes from my house in Taman Segar!

I ordered the Oolong BINQ, and wow… it completely exceeded my expectations.

The cream cheese was the star of the bowl for me. It added the perfect savoury touch that balanced the sweetness beautifully, making every bite incredibly satisfying without feeling overwhelming.

What impressed me the most was the texture of the shaved ice. Unlike the usual fluffy shaved ice that melts instantly, this one has a unique layered texture. You can actually feel the delicate strands of ice on your tongue, giving it a light bite at first. Then, just as you’re about to chew, it gently melts away, releasing the rich aroma of oolong tea. The tea fragrance lingers pleasantly on your palate long after each spoonful, making every bite so memorable.

On top of that, I think the pricing is very reasonable for the quality you get. Having tried quite a few shaved ice places, I genuinely feel BINQ offers excellent value for money without compromising on quality.

There are still so many flavours on the menu that we can’t wait to try, so we’ll definitely be back to explore more. This was such an impressive first visit, and I can totally understand why BINQ has become so popular recently. Highly recommended!
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

reviews.author: Shah Foyej
reviews.text: The best bingsu I've ever tried! The portion is huge. It was hard for just the two of us to finish, and it's easily enough for 3 to 4 people to share. Highly recommended if you're looking for delicious desserts. The staff are friendly, and the ambiance is great too.

reviews.author: M
reviews.text:
Nice refreshing dessert after meal on a hot day. Love their white peach oolong with standard toppings. Popping jelly is always my go to, elevates the flavour of the dessert.

Portion size recommended to share among two people.

reviews.author: Ewe Keat Huan
reviews.text:
Stopped by BinQ Dessert for a sweet treat, and it was a satisfying experience. The shaved ice was light, soft, and finely shaved, giving it a smooth texture that melted nicely in the mouth. There was a good variety of toppings to choose from, including boba pearls, crunchy cereal flakes, toasted bread cubes, and sweet sauces, allowing you to customise every bite.
The portions were generous, making it great for sharing with friends or family. The presentation was also neat and inviting, perfect for dessert lovers looking for something refreshing.
Overall, it's a nice place to cool down with a bowl of Taiwanese-style shaved ice. While it may not be the most unique dessert spot, the quality, variety of toppings, and generous portions make it worth a visit.
Overall: 4.0/5 ⭐

reviews.author: Ashley Hooi
reviews.text: had the teh tarik bingsu and its really good! great price and nice flavour depth. great service would come again

reviews.author: Emily Wong
reviews.text:
Nice texture of shaved ice, like the idea that Binq allows for us to select toppings.

Also tried their Dubai mochi & would eat again.

reviews.author: Rayna Tan
reviews.text:
BINQ has become one of my favourite dessert spots in KL.

I visit at least once or twice a week whenever I’m in the area, and it’s one of those places I keep coming back to because the quality is consistently good. The bingsu is light, flavourful and not overly sweet, and I love that many of the flavours are tea-based rather than the usual dessert options you find elsewhere.

What makes the experience even better is the people behind the brand. The owners are incredibly warm and passionate about what they do, and over time they’ve even come to recognise me from my frequent visits.

A place that serves great desserts is easy to find. A place that serves great desserts and makes customers feel genuinely welcomed is much rarer.

Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Karen Sun
reviews.text: Yummilicious bingsu. The best we ever had outside of Korea. Not cloyingly sweet. The bingsu is creamy and so fine.  New item Dubai chewy chocolate balls is so good.  Full of pistachio. Tasty

reviews.author: Vernie Chew
reviews.text: Ordered the top 1 roasted soybean oolong, good! and serving fast. Plenty of parking outside

reviews.author: Carpe Diem
reviews.text: I visited with some skepticism because the Korean bingsoo shop had closed down, but I was surprised by how delicious it was. It was a shame the pistachio flavor was sold out, but I will definitely visit again to try it next time.

reviews.author: Harris Hakimi
reviews.text: My go-to bingsu place!!! LOVE IT SO SO MUCH. flavours are immaculate and the prices are affordable, sesuai bawak family and friends! The staffs are friendly and lovely, just that kena makan for just 1hour to make way for other customers, understandable so yeah. Recommended!

reviews.author: Chonky the Shiba Woofer
reviews.text:
Binq SS15 is a solid spot, and their Thai Milk Tea kakigori is easily my favourite. It comes topped with crumbled Biscotti cookies, pandan gula melaka, and boba, but it manages to not taste overly sweet while keeping a prominent tea flavor.

The place itself is clean and well-maintained. Just keep in mind that it gets quite crowded at night, especially during the weekends, so you can expect queues and a time limit for dining in.

reviews.author: Hajar Aqielah
reviews.text: Always hits the spot! I literally am addicted to the Matcha Creme Brulee, the raya edition. Please make it a fixed menu because the matcha has really deep flavour, the creme brulee with a bit sweet and saltiness just perfectly in balance. Would highly recommend 😊

reviews.author: Baby Sumo
reviews.text:
✨ this insanely hot weather calls for some refreshing bingsu. My daughter have been wanting to try this dessert place in Taman Segar. Parking situation is a bit crazy here and the shop was also very busy when we visited, so
you may need to queue for a table.
✨ we had two of their bestsellers - the White Peach Oolong (RM17) and Mango Sago (RM18.50). I’ve not been to their other outlets but I read that the good thing about this Cheras outlet is that the Bingsu are available in small sizes. All the better so you can different flavours 👌🏻 the bingsu was very fine and melt in the mouth, nice distinct flavours. White Peach oolong one obviously had a strong tea flavou while mango sago tastes like mango what else 🤣 out of the two, I prefer the mango sago. The toppings are served on the side, so you can just add as you eat. The mango one had sago at the bottom. Didn’t really add the sauce cos it made it too sweet.
✨overall a very nice place for bingsu. Worth trying! 💯

reviews.author: Jac Yim
reviews.text:
Brought here by a friend. Ordered the best seller oolong soybean, mango sago and Thai milk tea.
The oolong soybean was nice. Mango is a little sweet for us. The highlight for me is the Thai milk tea. I really love the combination. Nicely finely shaved ice with onde onde glutinous squares, topped with crushed biscoff, and bubble coconut fillings. Absolutely delicious! A must try if you come here.

reviews.author: Lau Guan Zhen (Sean)
reviews.text:
Binq Dessert is a cozy spot in SS15 for cooling treats and sweet cravings. Their menu has a nice mix of traditional Chinese-style desserts and modern favorites — from tong sui and grass jelly bowls to shaved ice and fruity creations. Everything is light, refreshing, and not overly sweet, which makes it perfect after a meal or on a hot day.

The shop has a simple, comfortable setup, ideal for chilling with friends or enjoying a quick dessert break. Prices are reasonable, and portions are good for sharing too.

A great dessert spot in SS15 for anyone who enjoys cool, refreshing, and satisfying sweet treats. 🍧✨

reviews.author: Nim Tata
reviews.text:
Quite crowded and the seating is a bit cramped, you can easily hear conversations from nearby tables. The self service bingsu and utensil area is also placed too close together, so when many people are trying to get bingsu or spoons at the same time, it blocks the walkway and becomes inconvenient.

The bingsu itself has a soft and fluffy texture, and the toppings are decent. But the cream cheese is a must add, it tastes absolutely amazing!

reviews.author: Fish Yeo
reviews.text: We tried different flavours of bingsu, and I like the pistachio and hojicha the most! They taste really good~ The texture is very smooth and refreshing, and the sweetness is just nice without being too heavy. The white peach oolong was just average for me.

reviews.author: Ohaiyo Simidaa
reviews.text:
The bingsu here is good. We tried the soybean and pistachio flavours, and both were rich, thick, and very tasty. You can choose two add-ons, and I highly recommend adding the chocolate butter crisps — they enhance the flavour and add a nice crunch to the bingsu.

Prices start from around RM24 and above for a bowl of bingsu, which is generous enough to be shared by two people.

The environment is slightly warm, and the interior design is quite simple. Overall, it’s a nice spot for dessert, especially if you’re coming mainly for the bingsu rather than the ambience.

reviews.author: CW Wong
reviews.text:
Good desert place for bingsu. Well portioned and good price point!

We had the peach oolong one. The ice is fluffy and so soft, but well flavoured. Had no idea how to eat so wife poured the toppings on the mountain of ice and some fell on the floor 🙀

However this outlet had a strange smell, like something rotting. It made us not want to linger too long.
